title: Cupola block cracked by a 4.5 cm hit: the commander focuses the dark block, then a clear one
caption: COMMANDER / CRACKED CUPOLA BLOCK - HOLD RMB - CLEAR BLOCK
historical_scope: Staged fixture: two strikes applied through the ordinary exterior-damage path before the clip (a 4.5 cm round on cupola block 2, a 7.62 cm round on the left track band). Lt. Zabel's report (3./s.Pz.Abt. 503, 10-11 Feb 1943) records a 4.5 cm cupola hit leaving a vision block jammed and opaque. The opaque block renders as no exterior view; its source face keeps its opaque material.
